replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: This was tested 6 times on Avicade. Unfortunately, it did not play well. There are too many obstacles, the webs were rather annoying to go through, the minotaur has almost no chance to get through the webs in time, and it seems very laggy for some reason. As well as there being random quartz outside the map, I would happily update it if you could create some improvements for me so it plays better. Thank you!
